challenge.description: Waxaan diyaarinaynaa wax kasta oo loo baahan yahay si aad u sii wadato.
challenge.details.body: Hubintan gaaban waxay ka caawisaa websaytka inuu qof walba u furnaado. Biraawsarkaagu wuxuu sameeyaa xisaabin yar si loo xaqiijiyo booqashadan.
challenge.details.randomx: Hubinnada u baahan awood dheeraad ah oo CPU ama xusuus ah, sida RandomX, waxay ku weydiinayaan oggolaanshahaaga ka hor inta aanay bilaaban. Waad ka bixi kartaa boggan haddii aadan rabin inaad sii wadato.
challenge.hashwx_unsupported: Biraawsarkan ma socodsiin karo HashWX. Waxaa loo baahan yahay taageerada WebAssembly iyo Web Workers.
challenge.javascript_required: Fadlan JavaScript ka shid biraawsarkaaga, dabadeed dib u cusboonaysii boggan.
challenge.load_error: Hubintii ma bilaaban karin. Xidhiidhku wuu gaabnaan karaa ama fayl ayaa laga yaabaa in la xidhay.
challenge.randomx_unsupported: Biraawsarkan ma socodsiin karo RandomX. Waxaa loo baahan yahay biraawsar taageera WebAssembly, BigInt iyo Web Workers.
challenge.retry_after: Fadlan isku day mar kale {seconds} ilbiriqsi ka dib.
challenge.state.blocked.description: Waxaa suurtagal ah in kordhin biraawsar ama shaandho shabakad ay xirtay faylka hubintan uu u baahan yahay. Ogolow websaytkan kordhinta gudaheeda, kadibna mar kale isku day.
challenge.state.blocked.status: Waad isku dayi kartaa mar kale.
challenge.state.blocked.title: Wax baa joojiyay hubinta
challenge.state.connecting.title: Waa la xiriirinayaa
challenge.state.consent.description: Hubintani waxay isticmaashaa awood dheeraad ah oo CPU-ga iyo xusuusta qalabkaaga ah. Waxay bilaaban doontaa oo keliya haddii aad oggolaato inaad sii wadato.
challenge.state.consent.status: Waxaan diyaar nahay marka aad oggolaato.
challenge.state.consent.title: Hal tallaabo oo keliya ayaa hadhay
challenge.state.cookies.description: Websaydkani wuxuu isticmaalaa kuki si uu u xasuusto in biraawsarkaagu ka gudbay hubinta. U oggolow kukiyada boggan, dabadeed mar kale isku day.
challenge.state.cookies.status: Kukiyada waa la damiyey ama la xannibay.
challenge.state.cookies.title: Kukiyada waa la xannibay
challenge.state.expired.description: Hubintu waxay qaadatay wakhti ka badan intii la filayay. Hubin cusub ayaa laga yaabaa inay caawiso.

challenge.state.expired.title: Aan mar kale isku dayno
challenge.state.failed.description: Markan ma awoodin inaan dhamaystirno hubinta. Isku dayga xiga ayaa laga yaabaa inuu guulaysto.

challenge.state.failed.title: Fadlan mar kale isku day
challenge.state.fast.description: Biraawsarkaagu wuxuu samaynayaa hubin degdeg ah. Caadi ahaan, hawshani si toos ah ayay u dhammaataa.
